envelope.description: Resolve the Epic anchor in one place and stamp it

body.title: Resolve the Epic anchor in one place and stamp it
body.summary: Add resolveEpicAnchor (by head kind) and stampRootAnchor next to readEpicCreatedAt; remove the LLD-own-createdAt fallback from readEpicDefinitionCore; make workItemAnchorCreatedAt require the stamp and raise MissingAnchorError; make finalizeDefine, finalizeBrainstorm, finalizeIssue and finalizeStandaloneLld (always, even as the first record) stamp epicCreatedAt through stampRootAnchor. The record-folder helpers and the ledger writers are left to t6.
acceptanceChecks: resolveEpicAnchor returns the DEF or ISSUE head's createdAt, a stamped LLD head's stamp, and undefined for an unstamped LLD head
workItemAnchorCreatedAt throws MissingAnchorError without a stamp
each root producer stamps epicCreatedAt and a later record reads it
a work item with a DEF head keeps its existing folder

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/anchor-resolver.test.ts: resolveEpicAnchor by head kind, an unstamped standalone LLD head yields undefined, and workItemAnchorCreatedAt raises MissingAnchorError without a stamp
src/workflow/__tests__/anchor-producers.test.ts: every root producer stamps epicCreatedAt and later records read it
